content.value: Julie Spengel started her own consulting firm, Spengel Consulting on May 1, (25) 2014. The following transactions occurred during the month of May.
2014 May-1Spengel invested \$ 8,000 cash in the business.
2Paid \$ 800 for office rent for the month.
3 Purchased \$ 500 of office supplies on account.
5 Paid \$ 50 to advertise in the country news.
20Paid for the supplies purchased on account on May3.
23 Received a cash payment of \$ 2000 for services provided on account on May 15.
26 Purchased office equipment for \$ 2,400 on account
30 Borrowed \$ 5,000 from the Bank on a note payable.
Instruction: Journalize above the transactions in the book of Julie Spengel.
